newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Europay sees soaring market share in Finland.
newsitem.headline: Europay sees soaring market share in Finland.

text.p: European payment system Europay International forecast its market share in Finland would rise to 20 from five percent within the next two years after Finnish banks said they would issue and accept Europay-linked products.
"This will bring Europay's position in Finland more into line with its European lead of the payments business," it said in a statement.
Europay said banks in Finland represented the last remaining weak spot in Europe for its brand presence.

The three concerned banks - Merita, Postipankki and OKO Pankki - represent 80 percent of the total banking market in Finland, it said. Europay said they had all committed to issue Europay products, beginning with Eurocard-MasterCard card services.
At the end of last year, Europay said its share of the overall European cards market stood at 59 percent.
